issues.description: The solution implementation declares toString() with the return type Object (public Object toString()), while the problem statement and Java convention expect a toString() override that returns String. This mismatch will cause a compilation error (incompatible return type / failed override) and prevents the class from correctly overriding Object.toString(), confusing students about the required signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() method signature in the solution to return String (public String toString()) and keep the @Override annotation. Ensure the returned value is a String. Also update any example or template comments to indicate the correct signature so students implement/override toString() with return type String.
